recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Sales documents/history and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. The partial unique rule for sales_invoices.source_delivery_id, active-reservation partial uniqueness, and all independent Sales query/performance indexes remain deferred to Phase 03.07. tax_code_id foreign keys remain deferred until the Purchasing/Tax constraint slice establishes the canonical tax_codes key target.
